title: Night Bus Frequencies
description: A four-track EP recorded during late-night commutes between two studios. Field recordings of bus engines and rain are layered under minimal synth loops.
facts: The whole EP was tracked on a single borrowed interface.
Track 3 uses a sample of the 02:14 night bus announcement.

title: Paper Grooves
description: Sleeve artwork series for friends' self-releases: risograph-style scans of torn paper, halftone dots and hand-lettered titles.
facts: Each piece was printed at home on a modified inkjet.
The lettering is drawn with a nib pen, then scanned at 1200 dpi.

title: Static Bloom
description: Our zine-and-single combo: six collages responding to six short tracks, made in a shared weekend session and released together.
facts: Every artist had 60 minutes per piece, no do-overs.
The zine folds into a poster.
